title: Fri 06 Nov 2026: AI selloff hits Wall Street and Asia, Bank of England hikes to four percent, FCA sanctions and quantum, active ETFs spread
summary: An artificial intelligence selloff sends the Nasdaq down more than five percent and the S&P five hundred down over four percent, with Asian chipmakers sliding this morning. The Bank of England raises Bank Rate to four percent by eight votes to one and sees inflation near five percent next year. In regulation, new FCA items on UK EMIR, sanctions and quantum, plus the fund liquidity and T plus one timetables. In funds, active ETFs expand across Europe. Three COO action points and the diary for the week.
